title: Dreams Estate
fullTitle: Dreams Estate  - Modern Real Estate platform
description: A comprehensive real estate platform for buying, selling, and renting properties with advanced search and secure management.
purpose: Dreams Estate simplifies property transactions by centralizing listings, enhancing transparency between owners and seekers, and providing a seamless management dashboard.
features: Private Routes: Only authenticated users can access listing details.
CRUD Operations: Users can Add, Update, and Delete their own property listings.
Advanced Filtering: Search by location, price range, and property type.
User-Specific Data: Personalized dashboard to view own properties and ratings.
Secure Booking: Users can view recent properties and book them instantly.
Rating System: Integration of @smastrom/react-rating for property feedback.

title: Travel
description: A modern full-stack Travel Planning and Review Platform that allows users to explore destinations, browse hotels & rooms, shop travel products, manage wishlist and cart in real-time, book packages with multi-criteria filtering (location, date, guests), write reviews, and complete secure payments via SSLCommerz. The platform features dual-role dashboards (User/Admin), full bilingual support (English & Bangla) with Next-intl, private routes, forgot/reset password flow, blog section, and a responsive, animated UI optimized for all devices.
purpose: To provide a complete, secure, and user-friendly digital solution for travelers in Bangladesh and beyond — enabling seamless destination discovery, booking, shopping, reviewing, and payment while giving admins full control over users, products, destinations, orders, and content.
features: Secure dual-role dashboard (User & Admin) with NextAuth.js authentication (credentials + Google/GitHub), private routes, and forgot/reset password system
Real-time cart & wishlist management powered by TanStack Query for smooth state handling and caching
SSLCommerz payment gateway integration with full order tracking (success/fail/cancel flows)
Multi-criteria filtering system (location, date range, number of guests) for destinations, hotels, and packages
Full site localization (i18n) with Next-intl supporting English and Bangla
Destination exploration, popular destinations, hotel/room listings, travel product shop, blog, and user reviews & comments
Admin dashboard for managing users, products, destinations, orders, blogs, and reviews
Dark mode support, responsive UI/UX, and smooth animations with Framer Motion

title: Sharif Academy
fullTitle: Sharif Academy - Online Learning & Skill Development Platform
description: Sharif Academy is a modern full-stack online learning platform designed for Bangla-speaking students. It offers affordable skill-based courses in Programming, Graphic Design, Digital Marketing, Freelancing, English, and Business. Users can register, browse courses by category, enroll via subscription plans, take topic-wise MCQ exams with negative marking, view detailed results, earn certificates, and learn from industry expert teachers — all from home with lifetime access and a 30-day refund guarantee.
purpose: To make world-class skill education accessible and affordable for students in Bangladesh by removing the need for physical travel, providing expert-led Bangla courses, regular topic-wise exams, recognized certificates, and flexible subscription plans that help learners build real careers.
features: Secure authentication system with email/password, Google, and Facebook login powered by better-auth, including forgot password flow
Course catalog with category filtering (Programming, Graphic Design, Digital Marketing, Freelancing, English, Business) and popular/trending courses
Topic-wise MCQ exam system with auto-submit, negative marking (0.25), score calculation, and detailed result page showing correct/wrong answers
Subscription plans (Basic, Pro, Team/Institution) with certificates, lifetime access, live class access, mentoring, and 30-day money-back guarantee
Expert teacher profiles, student success stories, and educational blog/resources section
Question interaction features (like, dislike, favourite, view count) stored in PostgreSQL
Full Bangla-first interface with i18n support, math formula rendering (KaTeX), responsive design, and modern UI with Tailwind CSS
User dashboard for tracking enrolled courses, exam history, and progress

title: Career Track
fullTitle: Career Track Lite - Job Application Tracker
description: Career Track Lite is a full-stack job application tracking platform that helps job seekers eliminate the chaos of managing multiple applications. Users can register securely, add applications with company name, job title, source (LinkedIn, Bdjobs, etc.), status, date and notes, then track everything from a clean dashboard. The system shows instant counts of applications at every stage (Saved → Applied → Assessment → Interview → Rejected → Offer) along with search, filter, sort and recent activity.
purpose: To give job seekers a single, organized place to track every application’s status, source and progress so they can clearly see how many opportunities sit at each stage and never lose track of their job search.
features: Secure JWT-based authentication (register/login) with protected routes and user profile
Centralized dashboard showing total applications and live status counts (Saved, Applied, Assessment, Interview, Rejected, Offer)
Full CRUD for job applications: company name, job title, job URL, source, status, application date and notes
Advanced search, filter by status/source and multi-field sorting (date, company, status)
Application details view and edit functionality with ownership protection
Recent applications list on the dashboard for quick overview
Dark mode support and fully responsive UI built with Tailwind CSS
Clean, modern interface focused on reducing job-search anxiety and improving organization

title: Mini ERP
fullTitle: Mini ERP – Inventory & Sales Management System
description: Mini ERP is a full-stack Inventory & Sales Management System focused on the frontend experience. It provides JWT-based login, role-based protected routes (Admin, Manager, Employee), a statistics dashboard with low-stock alerts, complete product CRUD with search, pagination and image upload, and a multi-product sales flow with automatic total calculation. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit for auth state and TanStack Query for server-state management.
purpose: To give small businesses a clean, role-aware inventory and sales management interface where employees can view products and create sales while managers and admins can fully manage the product catalog, all backed by a secure JWT-authenticated API.
features: JWT-based authentication with secure login and session management via Redux Toolkit
Protected routes and role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Employee)
Dashboard with statistics cards and low-stock product list for quick inventory overview
Product management: list, search, pagination, add, edit, delete with image upload support
Role-aware UI that hides Add/Edit/Delete product actions from the Employee role
Sales creation flow supporting multiple products, quantity input and automatic grand-total calculation
Server state handled by TanStack Query (fetching, caching, mutations) and Axios HTTP client
Modern UI built with Tailwind CSS v4 and Shadcn/ui components

title: Care.xyz
description: Care.xyz is a trusted caregiving web platform that helps users easily find and book reliable babysitting, elderly care, and special home care services. It offers secure authentication, location-based booking, cost calculation, and booking tracking to make caregiving simple, safe, and accessible.
purpose: Care.xyz aims to make caregiving services easy, secure, and accessible by providing a platform to hire professional caretakers based on duration and location.
features: Dynamic Booking: Location-based hiring with total cost calculation.
Service Management: Specialized categories (Baby Care, Elderly, Sick Care).
Booking Tracking: "My Booking" page for Pending/Confirmed/Completed status.
Secure Auth: Email/Password and Google Social Login via NextAuth.
Notifications: Automatic email alerts using Nodemailer.
Next.js Power: Fast performance with Server Components and App Router.
